name: Cinnamon Brioche Knot Box
description: A box of six laminated brioche knots brushed with cinnamon sugar glaze. Rich, pillowy, and fragrant — the ultimate comfort bake.

name: Cold Brew Tasting Flight
description: A curated tasting flight of three house-made cold brews — classic, nitro, and a seasonal infused variation. A refreshing experience for hot Hong Kong afternoons.

name: Single Origin Pour-Over Voucher
description: A hand-brewed single origin pour-over coffee voucher redeemable at participating specialty cafés across Hong Kong. Perfect for the coffee connoisseur who appreciates nuanced flavour profiles.
